title: Design System: Kayooh Renter — Poster Solidaritas
scope: apps/web (renter) route group only; the (owner) and (admin) groups carry their own worlds.

components.name: Action Bar
components.description: The primary boxed-ink CTA: yellow keyline, kicker summarising the choice, verb in Archivo Black, yellow arrow.
components.html: COMMUTER · SIANG · 05/11Lihat ketersediaan
components.css: .ds-action-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 72px; padding: 12px 18px; background: #171009; color: #F0E3C4; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #F2B300; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 120ms ease; } .ds-action-bar:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-action-bar:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-action-bar__text { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; } .ds-action-bar__text small { display: block; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 8.5px; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F2B300; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-action-bar__text b { display: block; margin-top: 5px; font-family: 'Archivo Black', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.1; color: #F0E3C4; } .ds-action-bar__arrow { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #F2B300; }

components.name: Segment Cell
components.description: One cell of a ruled segmented picker (waktu or jenis). Pressed state floods Merah Cetak with paper text.
components.css: .ds-segment { flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 4px 9px; border: 0; border-right: 3px solid #171009; background: transparent; color: #171009; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-segment:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-segment:hover { background: #E6D6AE; } .ds-segment[aria-pressed="true"] { background: #B81B0D; color: #F0E3C4; } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #12408C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hour Block (selected)
components.description: The chosen waktu cell — Biru Lapis with Kuning Matahari text and an inset yellow keyline. The blue appears nowhere else.

components.name: Tutup Chip

components.name: Count Grid
components.description: Four ruled tabular columns (COM/ROD/MTB/FIX). Zeros in warm Nol grey; the selected category floods Kuning Matahari.
components.css: .ds-count-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border: 2px solid #171009; margin: 10px 0 0; } .ds-count-grid__cell { padding: 7px 4px 8px; text-align: center; border-right: 2px solid #171009; } .ds-count-grid__cell:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-count-grid__cell dt { font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #171009; } .ds-count-grid__cell dd { margin: 3px 0 0; font-family: 'Archivo Black', Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #171009; } .ds-count-grid__cell--dipilih { background: #F2B300; } .ds-count-grid__nol { color: #6E6350; }

narrative.overview:
Kayooh's renter website is one printed poster that works: a silkscreen field in deep print red on paper cream, the bicycle drawn in a single cream line, the promise running around the sheet as a set border, and every control set inside the printing. Tegas, jujur, tanpa basa-basi: the page never asks for trust it hasn't shown, and it never decorates what it can prove.

The world commits to flat ink. No gradients, no soft shadows, no rounded cards — depth comes from hard 3 px ink keylines and the collision of flat fields. Type is two voices: Archivo Black for display and Archivo for labels, body and figures. Numbers are set in Archivo Black with tabular figures; rupiah and distances never drift across columns.
keyCharacteristics: Paper cream ground, deep print red emblem field, sun yellow stamp accents, ink outlines, one lapis blue reserved for the chosen hour block.
Repeating slogan border as page chrome (Indonesian above, English below), the one authored motion moment.
Ruled tabular count columns (COM/ROD/MTB/FIX) instead of cards; zero inked in a warm AA-passing grey.
Every claim about stock is computed live from the server response; failure states are honest and in the same vocabulary.
Hard-edged everything; rotation allowed only for the siap stamp (−1.2deg).

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Biru Lapis appears only on the chosen hour block. If blue starts meaning anything else, the color system has failed.

rules.name: The Deep Red Rule
rules.body: Small text sits on #B81B0D or on paper; never on #DC2110. The hot pass is for graphics and decorative glyphs only.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every figure that stacks in a column uses tabular numerals. Figures never wobble.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display is Archivo Black, everything else is Archivo. No third face, no mono, no serif.

rules.name: The Flat-Ink Rule
rules.body: If a treatment would read as elevation (soft blur, offset shadow, glow), it is rejected. Print passes overlap; they do not float.

dos: Do compute every stock figure from the live response (sum of per-category counts, open-outlet count); the poster never invents a number.
Do keep the world's vocabulary on every new element: keylines, flat fields, tabular figures, uppercase labels.
Do reserve Biru Lapis for the chosen hour block.
Do keep small text on #B81B0D or on paper; the hot #DC2110 is for graphics only.
Do render zero counts in Nol (#6E6350) — visible, quiet, honest.
Do label synthetic/demo data as such when present (the dev database seeds are demo data).
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion — the slogan drift is the only animation and it stops.
donts: Don't introduce rounded corners, soft shadows, gradients, or glass anywhere in the renter group.
Don't use the hot red #DC2110 as a background for text.
Don't add a third typeface, an icon set, or emoji in place of drawn SVG/typography.
Don't show bike ids, asset tags, or per-bike rows — counts only (NEG-2).
Don't claim a time-of-day affects stock; the waktu picker sets context, never a filter.
Don't apply these rules to owner or admin surfaces — they have their own worlds.
Don't fabricate prices, testimonials, or outlet metrics anywhere in the world.
